title: Move the dotcom sync worker to @clerk/backend v2
reason: The reply says the work was picked up in #10751 and went directly to Clerk backend v3, which supports OAuth tokens, while calling out a stricter missing-azp behavior. This is a proposed/linked upstream dependency upgrade, not confirmed as deployed here.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not use the upstream Clerk sync worker; no authentication dependency change is implied.

title: European Portuguese translations are largely Brazilian Portuguese
reason: Reports that 178 of 237 pt-PT strings are identical to pt-BR due to automated Google translations producing Brazilian terms, creating materially incorrect regional localization. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is an upstream localization quality finding; Varve's pt-PT translations were not audited by this issue review.

title: Undo after a remote delete resurrects a shape with a missing parent
reason: The upstream report is concrete, but Varve uses container child lists and full-revision history; its current merge path returns an edit-vs-delete conflict and drops the deleted parent/child together with valid document state. A prior local reproduction and focused tests found no analogous orphan-parent result. Live remote collaboration is not implemented, so the simultaneous remote-delete trigger is not applicable.

varveAssessment.reproduction: Base frame+child; ours edits child; theirs deletes frame; mergeDocuments returned edit-vs-delete, with frame:false, child:false, and validateDocument(...).valid true.
varveAssessment.tests: pnpm exec vitest run packages/history/src/__tests__/merge.test.ts packages/history/src/__tests__/resolveMerge.test.ts packages/scene/src/document-validation.test.ts packages/scene/src/document-nodes.test.ts — 3 files, 47 tests passed.
varveAssessment.remainingQuestion: No live collaboration backend exists; reevaluate if concurrent remote history is introduced.

title: Add a user-facing way to turn off text outlines
reason: Requests a user-facing control for a readability text-shadow outline that currently only has an SDK-level shape option. The motivating request is plain white text without the outline. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Potential typography preference for design work; Varve's text outline behavior and controls were not inspected here.

title: The locale prop on <Tldraw> does not change the UI language
reason: Reports that a documented `<Tldraw locale>` prop reaches the loading screen translation provider but not the actual UI context provider, which instead reads user/default preferences. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's localization surface and precedence contract were not compared against this upstream SDK prop.

title: markHistoryStoppingPoint docs wrongly say that creating a mark clears the redo stack
reason: Shows source behavior preserving redo entries in `HistoryManager._mark()` despite JSDoc claiming they are cleared. This is an API documentation correctness issue; no comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: No Varve SDK-compatible `markHistoryStoppingPoint` API documentation was inspected.

title: License page says hobby licenses send no data, but watermarked licenses are tracked
reason: Reports a contradiction between upstream license privacy copy and `LicenseManager` behavior that sends watermark tracking requests with license and environment metadata. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: This concerns upstream commercial license tracking and privacy claims; Varve's local license behavior and site copy were not implicated.

title: Offset pasted shapes when they would land exactly on top of the originals
reason: Requests a small cascade offset for paste-at-center when originals remain visible; the only comment specifies cascading, an SDK option if feasible but default-off, and only the paste-at-center path. Preserve these constraints rather than assuming all paste modes should offset.

varveAssessment.assessment: A plausible paste-success feedback improvement, but Varve clipboard placement defaults and saved user expectations were not inspected.

title: Allow finer control over pen stroke width than the four preset sizes
reason: Varve already exposes arbitrary stroke weight in the Stroke inspector as a numeric px field (not only four presets), with a minimum of zero and direct per-selection editing. The user request for more than four sizes is therefore already satisfied; no additional control is needed for this issue.

varveAssessment.assessment: Inspected `packages/editor/src/components/Inspector/sections/StrokeSection.tsx`: the stroke weight is a `NumberField` with `unit="px"`, `step={1}`, `min={0}`, and writes the weight to the selected stroke. This provides finer arbitrary control than four presets.

title: Show a placeholder visual on bookmark cards that have no preview image
reason: Requests a recognizable designed placeholder when a bookmark lacks or cannot load an Open Graph preview image, improving visual distinction from ordinary text. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: A useful visual/product candidate; Varve bookmark preview and no-preview states were not inspected or visually evaluated.
